content: Research task: I need the REAL canonical content/patterns of the Claude Code skill "i-have-adhd" from the repository https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd (author ayghri). You are doing this to complete an "autofagia/helenização" absorption: the local copy only contains a thin SKILL.md whose "propósito" is literally the HTML `Claude Code` and has ZERO extracted patterns — the absorption failed. What I need you to return: 1. The actual content of the real SKILL.md of that repo (fetch via raw.githubusercontent.com or GitHub API: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd/main/SKILL.md — try main, then master). If the repo has skills/ subdir or .claude/skills/ etc., locate the real skill md. 2. Extract 4-8 concrete, canonical, actionable PATTERNS from that content (phrases/instructions that define HOW to behave ADHD-friendly: e.g. "give the answer first, put explanations after", "single answer / no burying the lede", formatting rules, brevity rules, etc.). Write each pattern as a concise imperative sentence (Portuguese or English, one line each). 3. A one-line purpose statement (the real purpose, NOT the HTML fragment). Return ONLY: purpose (1 line), then the pattern list (each "- " prefixed, one line). Do not write any files. This is research only — I will integrate the result myself.
